name: Native gold
definition: Native gold sold as a mineral specimen: nugget, crystal or wire, on or off matrix. A refined bar, round or coin sold by weight is in Coins, Stamps, Medals & Trading Cards.

name: Pyrite
definition: iron sulfide mineral specimen (cubes, clusters, suns, on or off matrix).

name: Fluorite
definition: calcium fluoride mineral specimen (crystals, clusters, octahedra, specimens on matrix, polished pieces).

name: Quartz
definition: Uncut quartz specimen, including rock crystal points and clusters, and tumbled or polished quartz, where no separate kind covers the variety.

name: Amethyst
definition: Uncut purple quartz: geode, point, cluster, tumbled stone, slab or sphere. A faceted or cabochon amethyst is under Cut amethyst in Gemstones & pearls.

name: Agate
definition: uncut or polished banded chalcedony specimen (nodule, geode, slab, tumbled stone).

name: Jasper
definition: Uncut or polished opaque microcrystalline quartz: rough, tumbled stone, slab or sphere.

name: Opal
definition: Opal specimen, matrix piece or uncut nodule. A loose opal cut as a cabochon or faceted, or opal rough sold for cutting, is under Cut opal.

name: Corundum
definition: Uncut corundum specimen, including ruby and sapphire crystals on or off matrix. Cut stones and cutting rough are under Sapphire and Ruby in Gemstones & pearls.

name: Calcite
definition: calcium carbonate mineral specimen (crystals, clusters, specimens on matrix).

name: Malachite
definition: copper carbonate mineral specimen (botryoidal or banded rough, polished pieces, slabs).

name: Barite
definition: Barium sulfate mineral specimen: bladed crystals, clusters and roses.

name: Tourmaline
definition: Uncut tourmaline specimen: crystals and clusters, on or off matrix. Cut stones and facet-grade rough sold by weight are under Cut tourmaline.

name: Garnet
definition: Uncut garnet-group specimen: crystals on or off matrix, and tumbled stones. Cut stones and cutting rough are under Cut garnet.

name: Granite
definition: coarse-grained intrusive igneous rock sample.

name: Basalt
definition: fine-grained extrusive igneous rock sample.

name: Obsidian
definition: natural volcanic glass sample.

name: Sandstone
definition: sedimentary rock sample of cemented sand grains.

name: Marble
definition: metamorphic rock sample of recrystallised carbonate.

name: Slate
definition: fine-grained foliated metamorphic rock sample.

name: Rock and mineral teaching set
definition: Kit of different labelled specimens (rocks, and minerals or fossils) sold as one standard set, usually for teaching. A mixed set not sold as a teaching kit goes with its most valuable item.

name: Ammonite
definition: Fossil ammonoid shell, whole, split, polished or on matrix, including unworked stones kept for a religious tradition.

name: Trilobite
definition: fossil trilobite, prepared on or off matrix.

name: Belemnite
definition: fossil belemnite guard or other straight cephalopod.

name: Echinoderm fossil
definition: fossil echinoderm (crinoid, starfish, sea urchin, blastoid).

name: Ammolite
definition: Gem-quality iridescent ammonite shell material, rough or cut.

name: Fossil shark tooth
definition: fossil tooth of a shark or ray.

name: Dinosaur fossil
definition: Fossil tooth, bone or claw of a dinosaur.

name: Fossil fish
definition: fossil fish, whole or partial, usually on matrix.

name: Petrified wood
definition: fossil wood replaced by silica or other minerals, rough, slab or polished.

name: Stromatolite
definition: layered fossil structure built by microbial mats, rough or polished.

name: Amber
definition: Fossilised tree resin, raw, polished or cut, with or without insects or other inclusions.

name: Copal
definition: young, partly fossilised tree resin, sold beside amber.

name: Iron meteorite
definition: meteorite made mainly of iron-nickel metal.

name: Pallasite
definition: stony-iron meteorite of olivine crystals in iron-nickel metal.

name: Carbonaceous chondrite
definition: chondrite rich in carbon compounds and water-bearing minerals.

name: Ordinary chondrite
definition: the common stony meteorite of chondrules (H, L, LL groups).

name: Lunar meteorite
definition: achondrite meteorite ejected from the Moon.

name: Martian meteorite
definition: achondrite meteorite ejected from Mars.

name: Tektite and impactite
definition: natural glass or rock formed by a meteorite impact (tektites, impact glass, impactites).

name: Diamond
definition: loose cut diamond, or diamond cutting rough, graded on the colourless-to-light-colour scale.

name: Fancy-colour diamond
definition: Loose diamond of natural fancy colour, graded on the separate coloured-diamond scale.

name: Sapphire
definition: loose cut corundum of any colour but red, or sapphire cutting rough.

name: Ruby
definition: Loose cut red corundum, or ruby cutting rough.

name: Emerald
definition: loose cut green beryl, or emerald cutting rough.

name: Cut spinel
definition: Loose cut spinel, or spinel cutting rough.

name: Cut amethyst
definition: Loose faceted or cabochon amethyst, or amethyst cutting rough. Uncut amethyst specimens are under Amethyst in Minerals & crystals.

name: Cut garnet
definition: Loose faceted or cabochon garnet of any species, or garnet cutting rough. Uncut specimens are under Garnet in Minerals & crystals.

name: Cut tourmaline
definition: Loose faceted or cabochon tourmaline, or facet-grade tourmaline rough sold by weight. Uncut specimens are under Tourmaline in Minerals & crystals.

name: Cut topaz
definition: loose cut topaz, or topaz cutting rough.

name: Tanzanite
definition: loose cut blue-violet zoisite, or tanzanite cutting rough.

name: Cut opal
definition: Loose opal cut as a cabochon or faceted, or opal rough sold for cutting. Opal specimens and uncut nodules are under Opal in Minerals & crystals.

name: Saltwater pearl
definition: loose undrilled pearl grown in a saltwater mollusc, natural or cultured.

name: Freshwater pearl
definition: loose undrilled pearl grown in a freshwater mussel, natural or cultured.

name: Cowrie
definition: shell of a cowrie (Cypraeidae).

name: Cone shell
definition: shell of a cone snail (Conidae).

name: Scallop shell
definition: shell or valve of a scallop (Pectinidae).

name: Coral skeleton
definition: Dead, dried skeleton of a coral. Living coral is not sold here; fossil coral is under Fossil coral.

name: Sea urchin test
definition: Dried, emptied shell (test) of a sea urchin.

name: Taxidermy bird mount
definition: bird skin preserved and mounted as in life.

name: Taxidermy mammal mount
definition: mammal skin preserved and mounted as in life (full mount, shoulder or head mount).

name: Mammal skull
definition: cleaned real skull of a mammal kept as a specimen.

name: Tusk specimen
definition: Real tusk or tusk section kept as a specimen. Ivory rules apply.

name: Egg or nest specimen
definition: Blown or emptied eggshell, or a dried nest, kept as a specimen. An egg for hatching is not sold here.

name: Antler or horn
definition: Real antler or horn kept as a specimen. An antler chew for dogs is in Animal Equipment.

name: Fish jaw or teeth set
definition: dried jaw or set of teeth of a fish or shark kept as a specimen.

name: Pinned butterfly or moth
definition: dried, pinned or spread lepidopteran specimen, framed or unframed (a frame fixed to the one specimen is part of the object).

name: Feather specimen
definition: Feather kept and labelled as a specimen. Craft feathers are in Craft & Art Supplies.

name: Herbarium sheet
definition: Pressed, dried plant mounted on a sheet as a specimen. Dried flowers for decor are in Decor.

name: Insect in resin
definition: real insect or small animal specimen embedded in a clear resin block.

name: Fluid-preserved specimen
definition: Wet specimen of an animal or other organism kept in preserving fluid in a jar.

name: Element ampoule
definition: sample of a chemical element sealed in a glass ampoule.

name: Element cube
definition: sample of a chemical element machined or cast as a cube of standard size.

name: Encased element sample
definition: sample of a chemical element embedded in a clear acrylic (Lucite) block.

name: Element crystal
definition: sample of a refined chemical element sold as a grown crystal or crystal fragment for its identity.

name: Specimen display dome
definition: glass or acrylic dome with a base, made to cover and display one specimen.

name: Specimen stand
definition: stand or mount made to hold and display one specimen.

name: Single-specimen box
definition: Box made to hold one specimen, such as a thumbnail box. A box holding several is in Furniture & Storage.

name: Fossil coral
definition: Fossil coral, solitary or colonial, rough, polished or on matrix. A dead modern coral skeleton is under Coral skeleton.

name: Fossil bivalve
definition: fossil clam, oyster, scallop or other bivalve shell, whole, opalised or on matrix.

name: Fossil brachiopod
definition: fossil lamp shell (brachiopod), loose, pyritised or on matrix.

name: Bryozoan fossil
definition: fossil bryozoan colony (moss animal), such as Archimedes screw or fenestrate lace, on or off matrix.

name: Fossil crustacean
definition: fossil crab, lobster, shrimp or other crustacean, usually in a nodule or on matrix.

name: Fossil insect
definition: Fossil insect or other land arthropod preserved in rock. An insect in amber or copal is under Amber or Copal.

name: Fossil gastropod
definition: fossil snail shell (gastropod), whole, agatised or on matrix.

name: Graptolite
definition: fossil graptolite colony, usually on a shale slab.

name: Fossil nautiloid
definition: Fossil coiled nautiloid shell, whole, split or polished. Straight nautiloids such as Orthoceras are under Belemnite.

name: Fossil sponge
definition: fossil sponge, whole or sectioned, loose or on matrix.

name: Trace fossil
definition: fossil track, footprint, burrow, boring or coprolite left by an organism rather than its body.

name: Fossil mammal
definition: Fossil tooth, bone or other part of a mammal, such as mammoth, cave bear or whale.

name: Plant fossil
definition: Fossil leaf, fern, frond, seed or cone, as an impression, compression or nodule. Petrified wood is separate.

name: Fossil reptile or amphibian
definition: fossil tooth, bone or skeleton of a non-dinosaur reptile (mosasaur, crocodile, plesiosaur), amphibian or synapsid.

name: Azurite
definition: copper carbonate hydroxide mineral specimen (blue crystals, nodules, with or without malachite).

name: Aragonite
definition: calcium carbonate (orthorhombic) mineral specimen (sputniks, clusters, flos-ferri).

name: Halite
definition: sodium chloride mineral specimen (cubic crystals, coloured or clear).

name: Hematite
definition: iron oxide mineral specimen (specular, botryoidal or rose crystals, tumbled pieces).

name: Beryl
definition: Uncut beryl specimen (aquamarine, morganite, heliodor, emerald crystals), on or off matrix. Cut stones are in Gemstones & pearls.

name: Topaz
definition: Uncut topaz crystal or specimen, on or off matrix. A faceted stone or cutting rough is under Cut topaz.

name: Turquoise
definition: copper aluminium phosphate mineral specimen (nuggets, veins on matrix, rough or polished, stabilised or not).

name: Lapis lazuli
definition: Uncut or polished lapis lazuli (a rock rich in lazurite), sold as a specimen. A cabochon is in Gemstones & pearls.

name: Serpentine
definition: Serpentine-group mineral or serpentinite specimen, rough, tumbled or polished.

name: Feldspar
definition: Uncut feldspar-group specimen, rough or polished: microcline, amazonite, labradorite, orthoclase, moonstone and sunstone. Cut stones are in Gemstones & pearls.

name: Rhyolite
definition: fine-grained silica-rich extrusive igneous rock sample (including rainforest and wonderstone rhyolite).

name: Porphyry
definition: igneous rock sample with large crystals in a fine-grained groundmass (e.g. Chinese writing stone).

name: Fulgurite
definition: natural tube or crust of silica glass fused by lightning in sand or rock.

name: HED meteorite
definition: achondrite of the howardite, eucrite and diogenite group, from asteroid Vesta.

name: Mesosiderite
definition: stony-iron meteorite of silicate breccia and iron-nickel metal in roughly equal parts.

name: Achondrite
definition: Stony meteorite without chondrules that is not lunar, Martian or HED: aubrites, angrites, ureilites and primitive achondrites.

name: Dried starfish
definition: Dried whole starfish (sea star) kept as a specimen. A fossil starfish is under Echinoderm fossil; craft assortments are in Craft & Art Supplies.

name: Murex shell
definition: shell of a murex or rock snail (Muricidae).

name: Volute shell
definition: shell of a volute (Volutidae).

name: Brachiopod shell
definition: Shell of a living-species brachiopod (lamp shell) kept as a specimen. Fossil brachiopods are under Fossil brachiopod.

name: Articulated skeleton
definition: Real animal skeleton, cleaned and articulated on a stand or in a case.

name: Claw or tooth specimen
definition: Real modern animal claw, talon or tooth kept as a specimen. Fossil teeth are under Fossils & amber.

name: Taxidermy reptile mount
definition: reptile skin preserved and mounted as in life (full mount or head).

name: Specimen frame case
definition: Glazed floating frame or case made to hold and display one specimen. One holding several, such as a Riker tray, is in Furniture & Storage.

name: Bird skull
definition: cleaned real skull of a bird kept as a specimen.

name: Reptile skull

name: Fish skull
